claim: Alexandr Stoianoglo wins the second round of the election for bashkan (governor) of Gagauzia on Sunday 29 November 2026.

runs.scenario: In a close race, the CEC and the Gagauz electoral council could publish preliminary snapshots that both meet the 95% threshold but show different leaders because they include different sets of polling-station protocols. If no final CEC results are available, the criterion does not say which preliminary snapshot takes precedence.
runs.yes_requires: The runoff must be held on 29 November 2026 within the stated Europe/Chisinau event window and must not be declared invalid. Stoianoglo must have more valid votes than Fiodor Gagauz in official preliminary results with at least 95% of polling-station protocols processed, unless final CEC results are available when the resolver reads, in which case those results control.
